title: Peaceful
summary: PE'ACEFUL, adjective Quiet; undisturbed; not in a state of war or commotion; as a peaceful time; a peaceful country. 1. Pacific; mild; calm; as peaceful words; a peaceful temper. 2. Removed from noise
